concepts.prompt: A woven-reed gabled entrance porch for the front of a round marsh-village reed hall: four thick driftwood posts lashed with rope holding a steep gabled roof of golden woven reed thatch, an open front gable with a teal-painted carved timber lintel beam across the front, two small brass hanging lanterns with warm glass hanging from the lintel, three wide wooden plank steps leading up to a low plank floor, woven reed side panels at waist height. Open at the back where it meets the hall. Real size about 4 m wide, 3 m deep, 4.5 m tall. Three-quarter front view. Stylised Palworld/Animo-class game prop concept, same family as the attached Tidewake woven reed hall and dock shelter: chunky readable shapes, warm sun-bleached weathered driftwood timber, golden woven reed and thatch, sun-bleached rope bindings, teal and sea-blue paint accents, cream sailcloth, clean hand-painted PBR finish. Use the attached boards only for palette, mood and finish quality. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no crimson, no maroon anywhere. Single isolated object, full object visible, plain neutral light background, no text, no labels, no people, no creatures.

concepts.verdict: CHOSEN (all three views): front 3/4 with carved teal lintel, two brass lanterns, three plank steps; consistent back and side views

visual_verdict: Strong and on-family: four rope-lashed driftwood posts, steep golden reed thatch gable, carved teal lintel and teal gable trim, two brass hanging lanterns, woven reed half-panels, three plank steps on the front. Fitted to 4 m width it is 3.15 m deep and 5.34 m tall (the brief asked 4.5 m; the steep roof adds height). Alternative uniform scale fitting 4.5 m height: 2.38 (3.37 x 4.5 x 2.66 m). Lanterns are mesh only, no emissive mask. Collision/walkable floor is the lane's job.
integration_note: candidate only; stays flag-off until its scene passes code-blind judging
palette_check: no red/oxblood requested or observed: driftwood brown, golden reed, sun-bleached rope, teal and cream accents, brass lanterns
